crew.overview: After being coerced into working for a crime boss, a young getaway driver finds himself taking part in a heist doomed to fail.
crew.title: Baby Driver

details.biography:
Paul Trewartha is a documentary editor known for The Sparks Brothers (2021) Produced by Nira Park, George Hencken and directed by Edgar Wright. The film was longlisted for the 2022 BAFTA award for Best Documentary, it won five other major awards and was nominated for a further 26. It is Certified Fresh on Rotten Tomatoes with a score of 95%.

Branson (2022) produced and directed by Chris Smith for HBO. Kipchoge: The Last Milestone (2021) Exec. produced by Ridley Scott and Kevin Macdonald, produced by Ross Plummer and directed by Jake Scott for Universal Pictures. Ronnie's (2020) Produced by Eric Woollard-White, Kirsty Bell and directed by Oliver Murray which premiered at DOCNYC in 2020 and Ferrari: Race to Immortality (2017) Produced by Julia Taylor-Stanley and directed by Daryl Goodrich for Universal Pictures which premiered at the 12th Rome Film Fest.
